entries.candidate: Goodman Sagamihara data-centre campus, (仮称)麻溝台・新磯野北部地区土地区画整理事業 (about 32.4 ha), Minami-ku, Sagamihara, Kanagawa
entries.reason: Re-checked 22 October 2026. Sagamihara City received the land-readjustment EIA scoping document (方法書) on 13 August 2026 and published it for inspection from 27 August to 25 September 2026 (city release sagamihara-1035920-0827-01.pdf, sha256 recorded in the capture metadata; project page 1033979.html updated 28 September). The proponent is the district's land-readjustment preparatory association with Goodman Japan Group and Nakajima Construction as prospective business agents, and the city EIA council took up the scoping document on 3 September 2026 (minutes sagamihara-eia-council-20260903.pdf). None of these in-window official records names a data centre: the scoping document describes 'securing industrial land' with roads, parks and utilities, and the council minutes contain no data-centre reference. The data-centre purpose rests only on Goodman's 28 May 2026 release and a 21 July trade report, both before the 85-day window (28 July 2026). The scoping document itself was viewable only during the inspection period and is no longer online. The adjacent south district is a separate land readjustment with a different proponent.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Goodman or Sagamihara City record (scoping-document opinion, draft EIS, district plan, urban-planning council material or Goodman release) that names the data-centre use of the north district; locator from the EIA project-area map registered to GSI tiles or from MOJ parcels for 南区麻溝台ろの原735番1 and neighbouring lots, labelled as the district rather than a building.
